test_title: PYST 48 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 30 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate preposition:

The committee is not authorized to act ____ behalf of the organization in international matters.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. on .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"on behalf of"** is a standard expression used to indicate that someone is acting as a representative or proxy for someone else.
 
• In this context, the committee is not authorized to represent the organization in international matters.
 
• Other options like **"in"**, **"for"**, or **"upon"** are incorrect, as they do not convey the intended meaning of representation.

Correct sentence: *The committee is not authorized to act **on** behalf of the organization in international matters*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Common Usage:** The phrase **"on behalf of"** is often used in formal contexts, such as legal documents or organizational communication.
 
• **Examples:**
 
 
• She accepted the award **on behalf of** her team.
 
• The lawyer spoke **on behalf of** the defendant.
